message:
I remember one evening when a sudden storm knocked out the power just as my favorite show was about to start—perfect timing, right? I had my trusty flashlight ready, but as I reached for my phone to check the weather, I realized it was almost out of battery! Talk about a panic moment! 

I quickly grabbed my power bank and plugged it in, feeling a wave of relief wash over me. It turns out, having a backup plan for our devices is just as important as having a good flashlight. 

How do you keep your tech charged during a blackout? I'm all ears for your tips! 💡
